neighbours.label: function words ('our', 'who', 'His') in Christian scriptural and devotional phrasing (glory of our God, all who call on the Lord)
fire: We wait for the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior.
For everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
Consider Jesus, the Apostle and High Priest of our confession.
He offers an eternal inheritance in heaven for all who trust in Him.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, says the Lord.
Give thanks to the Lord, for His mercy endures forever.
May the peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
Come to me, all who are weary, and I will give you rest.
quiet: We wait for the arrival of the director of our great company and team.
For everyone who calls the help desk before noon will get a reply.
Consider Smith, the founder and chief engineer of our company.
He offers a free coffee in the lobby for all who arrive early.
Lucky are those who find a parking space downtown, says the driver.
Give thanks to the cook, for his soup was really good tonight.
May the staff of our hotel be with you during your stay.
Come to the office, all who are new, and I will give you a badge.
